Container.Name: PlexMind
Container.Overview:
AI-powered Plex recommendations using a fully local llama.cpp LLM. Analyzes each user's watch history and generates personalized movie/TV picks with no cloud, no API costs, and no data leaving your server.
Also includes: Whisper ASR subtitle generation, llama.cpp-powered subtitle translation, and library maintenance tools.
Requires a llama.cpp server with the configured GGUF model (default alias: qwen3.5-9b-q5_k_m).
Web dashboard at http://[IP]:[PORT:8000]/
Container.Description: PlexMind API/dashboard component. Version line: v0.8.20. This safe template does not mount media or the Docker socket. Deploy the authenticated PlexMind scripts worker, recommendation worker, and Docker broker from the repository Compose stack before using jobs or schedules.

Variable.Name: PLEX_URL
Variable.Description: Your Plex Media Server URL (use LAN IP)

Variable.Name: PLEX_TOKEN
Variable.Description: Your Plex authentication token — find it at plex.tv/claim or in Plex web app preferences URL

Variable.Name: LLAMA_CPP_URL
Variable.Description: llama.cpp API URL — use LAN IP of the host running llama.cpp, not localhost

Variable.Name: WHISPER_API_URL
Variable.Description: Whisper ASR endpoint reachable from the PlexMind container

Variable.Name: LLAMA_CPP_MODEL_ALIAS
Variable.Description: llama.cpp model alias configured on the server

Variable.Name: TMDB_API_KEY
Variable.Description: Optional — enriches recommendations with ratings and posters. Free at themoviedb.org/settings/api

Variable.Name: PLEXMIND_API_KEY
Variable.Description: Required API secret. Generate a distinct value with openssl rand -hex 32.

Variable.Name: PLEXMIND_CONTROL_TOKEN
Variable.Description: Required scripts-worker token; must differ from every other PlexMind secret.

Variable.Name: PLEXMIND_BROKER_TOKEN
Variable.Description: Required Docker-broker token; must differ from every other PlexMind secret.

Variable.Name: PLEXMIND_WEBHOOK_SECRET
Variable.Description: Required scoped Plex webhook secret; must differ from every other PlexMind secret.

Variable.Name: PLEXMIND_SCRIPT_MODE
Variable.Description: Must remain remote for the least-privilege worker topology.

Variable.Name: SCRIPTS_API_URL
Variable.Description: Authenticated scripts-worker control URL.

Variable.Name: DOCKER_BROKER_URL
Variable.Description: Authenticated narrow Docker-broker URL.

Variable.Name: MAX_RECOMMENDATIONS
Variable.Description: Number of recommendations to generate per user

Variable.Name: SUPPRESSION_DAYS
Variable.Description: Days before a recommendation can reappear

Variable.Name: TZ
Variable.Description: Timezone for the scheduled monthly batch run

Variable.Name: WHISPER_CONTAINER_NAME
Variable.Description: Docker container to start before transcription and stop when transcription exits

Variable.Name: WHISPER_MODEL
Variable.Description: Configured sidecar model; the dashboard enables transcription only when this model exists in /whisper-cache

Variable.Name: WHISPER_MODEL_CACHE_DIR
Variable.Description: Read-only container path used to inventory locally downloaded Whisper models

Variable.Name: LLAMA_CPP_CONTAINER_NAME
Variable.Description: Docker container to start before translation and stop when translation exits

Variable.Name: START_SIDECAR_CONTAINERS
Variable.Description: Set to 1 to start Whisper/llama.cpp sidecars before script jobs

Variable.Name: MANAGE_LLAMA_CPP_CONTAINER
Variable.Description: Keep 0 when llama.cpp is shared/always-on; set 1 only for a dedicated on-demand container

Variable.Name: STOP_SIDECAR_CONTAINERS
Variable.Description: Set to 1 to stop Whisper/llama.cpp sidecars when script jobs exit
